description: Search YellowPages.com by keyword and location, browse a category, enrich business profile URLs, or replay any Yellow Pages search/category/profile URL.

categoryFilter.description: Apply Yellow Pages' own category filter where the site supports it.
categoryFilter.title: Category filter

detailUrls.description: Full Yellow Pages business profile URLs containing `/mip/`, e.g. `https://www.yellowpages.com/new-york-ny/mip/some-business-123456`.
detailUrls.title: Business profile URLs (mode=businessDetail)

fetchBusinessDetails.description: Visit each result's profile page to add hours, geo, description, email, services, brands, payments, social links and reviews.
fetchBusinessDetails.title: Fetch full business details

geoLocationTerms.description: A US city and state (`New York, NY`), a ZIP code (`10005`), or a neighborhood (`Brooklyn, NY`).
geoLocationTerms.title: Location (mode=search)

geoLocations.description: More cities, ZIP codes, or neighborhoods. Each location is cross-joined with every search term.
geoLocations.title: Additional locations (mode=search)

hasEmailOnly.description: Only keep businesses with a public email. Automatically turns on profile-page enrichment.
hasEmailOnly.title: Has an email only

hasWebsiteOnly.description: Only keep businesses that list a website.
hasWebsiteOnly.title: Has a website only

includeAds.description: Keep the sponsored cards Yellow Pages places above organic results. Turn off for organic-only lead lists.
includeAds.title: Include sponsored listings

includeClosedBusinesses.description: Keep businesses the site marks as closed. Turn off to drop permanently or temporarily closed listings.
includeClosedBusinesses.title: Include closed businesses

includeReviews.description: Add each business's reviews. This opens the profile page and follows review pages, so runs are slower.
includeReviews.title: Include customer reviews

maxDetailFetches.description: Cap on profile-page fetches for detail enrichment. 0 means no cap.
maxDetailFetches.title: Max detail pages per run

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted business records across all searches and URLs.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Stop each search or category after this many result pages. 0 means follow the source until it runs out.
maxPages.title: Max pages per search

maxReviewsPerBusiness.description: Review cap per business when `includeReviews` is on. 0 means collect every review the source serves.
maxReviewsPerBusiness.title: Max reviews per business

minRating.description: Only keep businesses rated at least this many stars. Businesses with no rating are kept.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviewCount.description: Only keep businesses with at least this many reviews. Unrated businesses are kept.
minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count

minYearsInBusiness.description: Only keep businesses that have operated at least this many years. Businesses without the badge are kept.
minYearsInBusiness.title: Minimum years in business

minYearsWithYellowPages.description: Only keep businesses with at least this many years on Yellow Pages. Businesses without the badge are kept.
minYearsWithYellowPages.title: Minimum years with Yellow Pages

mode.description: What to scrape: keyword search, category browse, known profile URLs, or pasted Yellow Pages URLs.
mode.title: Mode

open24HoursOnly.description: Only keep businesses whose status or hours say they are open 24 hours.
open24HoursOnly.title: Open 24 hours only

openNowOnly.description: Only keep businesses the site shows as open at scrape time.
openNowOnly.title: Currently open only

searchQueries.description: More keywords to run. Each term is cross-joined with every location, and duplicates are skipped.
searchQueries.title: Additional search terms (mode=search)

searchTerms.description: A business type or keyword, e.g. `restaurants`, `plumbers`, `Starbucks`. Leave blank to list every business at the location.
searchTerms.title: Search terms (mode=search)

sortBy.description: The same four orders Yellow Pages offers for search and category results.
sortBy.title: Sort order

startPage.description: Start at this results page. Useful when resuming a long search; ignored for profile URLs.
startPage.title: First result page

startUrls.description: Search-result URLs, category URLs, and business profile URLs. Address bars and `/mip/` links both work.
startUrls.title: Yellow Pages URLs (mode=startUrls)

title: YellowPages.com Business Directory Scraper Input
